title: Nico Collins: I started my career in Houston, want to end it there

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nico Collins: I started my career in Houston, want to end it there
sources.description: When trade rumors swirled about Texans wide receiver Nico Collins ahead of the draft, General Manager Nick Caserio didn't hesitate to make it clear that the team has no interest in parting ways with the wideout.
